dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: This shop is the exclusive seller of fine liquor from Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: Our ciders are all brewed from the purest water of Cider Lake and the freshest fruits from Mondstadt. We make sure that even here in Inazuma, our customers shall have the finest and the most authentic Mondstadt drinks!

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: So if you choose the finest liquor from Mondstadt, choose Sailing Breeze!
